name: Dollinger
beschreibung:
Situated at the foot of the dramatic Nordkette, the historic Hotel Dollinger welcomes travellers with deep-rooted Tyrolean charm and comfortable guest rooms. The on-site restaurant serves authentic local specialties and hearty regional fare.

Within minutes, visitors can explore Innsbruck's historic old town with the Golden Roof or board the Hungerburgbahn funicular to reach the alpine heights of the Karwendel mountains.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Hotel Restaurant Dollinger in Innsbruck offers genuine Tyrolean hospitality at the foot of the Nordkette range.
